links.outcome: Readability of chatbot VTE patient-education responses versus recommended sixth-grade level, using six indices
links.effect: All four chatbots had grade-level indices well above the sixth-grade benchmark; FRES ranged from 28.00 to 36.35 versus the recommended 80.
links.quote: Readability remained poor across all models, with grade level indices well above the recommended sixth grade benchmark and FRES values ranging from 28.00 to 36.35, far below the recommended threshold of 80.

screen.reason: Evaluates the reliability and readability of responses from multiple commercial LLM chatbots to patient questions about venous thromboembolism after fracture surgery, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
